svg.aria-label: UIUCTF 2026 Reverse Engineering writeup cover — all four RE challenges solved. vector-cache is an x86-64 ELF whose token verifier lives inside a SIGILL signal handler dispatched by a deliberate ud2 instruction, solved by GDB tracing with handle SIGILL nostop noprint pass and constraint satisfaction with minimum-remaining-values backtracking. GODMODE//999 is an AArch64 firmware plus 16 MiB RankedFS disk with a bait transaction 404 after the type-7 checkpoint, a custom SHA-256 variant that hashlib silently gets wrong, and a 13-op RAID//9 ARX replay VM inverted by backtracking commit and rollback choices, solved by emulating the real firmware routines under Unicorn. Veil of Evernight rebuilds 195,816 bytes with an embedded VM into a 466 by 341 PNG containing handwritten flag text where the visible plus-three resolves to t close-brace, solved by patching two ELF code-cave hooks into the untouched binary. glyphs is a 23 MB PIE whose interpreter walks a 13,915 by 13,843 bitmap and builds a lambda-calculus term graph returning nope or good, solved by dumping the final GLYPHTRM graph, running an offline call-by-need Thunk-based evaluator, decoding Scott-encoded Tree structures, and inverting body pairs with 7 bit-coded probes plus batches of 57 candidates per run
